aha: The left vault's contents tip left onto the gate unless that side is still sealed: open the pit side first so the stone drops into the pit and the pearl waits on the wedge, then open the gate side; count every pit before dropping a column and crush both the piranha and the crab with drops.
deadlocks: Opening the gate-side valve of the left vault first: the stone lands on the gate (walled in) and the pearl falls into the pit.
Pushing the right pearl along the trench before the pits at x=9 and x=16 are filled: it falls in.
Leaving the piranha or the crab alive: it is squeezed ahead of the pearl and blocks the trench.
